advice.scope_caveat: text-only overconfidence reads stated-confidence REGISTER, not actual calibration. Construct ceiling preregistration-confirmed (7c36ed9, H_null): held-out AUC 0.57–0.60 vs ≥0.70 bar. Confident phrasing fires this instrument even on factually correct, well-calibrated text. It also reads response LENGTH as a partial cue: a frontier matched-length audit (2026-06-25) found a length-INDEPENDENT register floor ~0.73 (CEM length-matched, 95% CI 0.62-0.81) plus a SEPARABLE length component (shipped AUC falls 0.86->0.74 when length is held constant). The cue is register-intrinsic, not a corpus artifact: even a frontier model told to write equal-length calibrated vs overconfident text writes calibrated ~22% longer (hedging costs words), so matched-GENERATION returns an honest null (e70f55e) and the cue is removable only by CEM subsampling, not re-generation. DEPLOYMENT BIAS (measured, orthogonal 2x2, 2026-06-25): discrimination is length-robust (within-stratum AUC 0.83-0.86) but the SCORE is length-biased (SHORT reads more overconfident) — at a fixed threshold a careful short answer is false-flagged ~46% vs ~4% when long, and a verbose overconfident one is missed ~46% vs ~4% when short. A length-aware threshold guard (residualize on log-words) raises AUC 0.81->0.85 and removes most of the bias; the fix is a deployment threshold, not a retrain. UNDER REVIEW in 7.4.1 composite.
